Premium Baby Blanket - Soft, Cozy, and Adorable!
Our premium baby blanket is made with love and care to provide your little one with warmth and comfort. Made from soft and breathable 100% materials, this blanket is perfect for newborns and toddlers.

Features:
- Soft and breathable materials
- Adorable baby pattern design
- Durable and long-lasting
- Easy to care for

Benefits:
- Provides a sense of security and comfort for your baby
- Regulates body temperature
- Promotes better sleep

Specifications:
- Size: 110x100 cm
- Color: Soft Pink, Grey, Brown
- Design: ribbon, mcky, peanut, and star
